evals.prompt: Design the minimum experiment matrix for an EEG-conditioned visual reconstruction claim with limited compute and likely reviewer concerns about leakage and baselines.
evals.expected_output: An experiment matrix with must-run, should-run, controls, ablations, statistics, stop rules, and reviewer-facing interpretation.

assertions.text: Output separates must-run, should-run, and nice-to-have experiments.
Output includes leakage checks and baseline parity.
Output includes negative controls and stop rules.
Output includes metric definitions or statistical plan.
